# SmartAssPDF — Complete Technical, Architecture & Tool Knowledge Base

> SmartAssPDF (https://smartasspdf.com) is a private, open-source-oriented document utility platform providing 24 live conversion, optical character recognition (OCR), repair, diffing, sanitization, signing, merging, splitting, compression, and security tools.

---

## 1. Architecture & Privacy Principles

SmartAssPDF operates under a **Zero-Permanent-Storage Architecture**:
1. **Stateless Processing**: There is no user database, no account login requirement, and no credit card paywall.
2. **Isolated Job Directories**: Each upload is assigned a unique UUID temporary directory on the host server (e.g. `/tmp/smartasspdf/{uuid}/`).
3. **Scheduled Cleanup**: All input files and converted outputs are scheduled for automatic hard deletion by a background cleanup daemon after 30 minutes.
4. **Dynamic Output Filenames**: Results retain the original uploaded filename base (e.g. `Contract_2026.pdf` → `Contract_2026_searchable.pdf`, `Contract_2026.docx`, or `Contract_2026_signed.pdf`).
5. **No AI Training on User Data**: Uploaded document streams are never logged, indexed, or used to fine-tune AI/ML models.

---

## 2. Technology & Engine Specifications

- **Frontend**: High-performance static HTML5, CSS custom properties (Dark Mode default with instant light theme switcher), vanilla JavaScript ES6 modules, client-side validation. Zero external tracking scripts.
- **Backend**: Spring Boot 3 on Java 17 LTS with asynchronous job management and Python 3.10+ native bridge worker.
- **Core Document Engines**:
  - **Apache PDFBox 3.0**: PDF manipulations, rasterization, font embedding, 256-bit AES encryption, permission enforcement, and page transformations.
  - **Tesseract OCR (v5+)**: Neural network LSTM OCR engine converting scanned bitmaps and flattened image PDFs into dual-layer searchable PDFs.
  - **QPDF (v11+)**: Structural PDF parser and repair engine for rebuilding damaged XREF tables, decompressing object streams, and fixing unreadable PDF syntax.
  - **PyMuPDF / fitz**: High-speed vector graphics analysis, layout parsing, pixel-level visual rendering, and textual diffing.
  - **Apache POI 5.x**: Microsoft Office OpenXML document handler for Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), and PowerPoint (.pptx).
  - **LibreOffice Headless**: Native document compilation engine for high-fidelity DOCX, XLSX, and HTML rendering.
  - **Pillow (PIL)**: High-performance image processing and WebP encoder preserving alpha transparency channels.

---

## 3. Tool Specifications & Technical Capabilities (24 Live Tools)

### OCR PDF (`/tools/ocr-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Single scanned or image-based PDF (`.pdf`) up to 50 MB.
- **Output**: Searchable and selectable PDF document (`.pdf`).
- **Processing**: Extracts rasterized page images, executes multi-language Tesseract OCR character segmentation, and overlays an invisible, selectable text font layer aligned with underlying bitmap characters.
- **Supported Languages**: English (`eng`), Spanish (`spa`), French (`fra`), German (`deu`).

### Repair PDF (`/tools/repair-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Corrupted, damaged, or unreadable PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Clean, standardized PDF document (`.pdf`).
- **Processing**: Executes QPDF deep stream reconstruction to rebuild damaged cross-reference (XREF) tables, recovers orphaned object streams, and re-encapsulates valid page trees.

### Compare PDFs (`/tools/compare-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Two PDF documents (`.pdf`) representing original and modified versions.
- **Output**: Visual & textual comparison diff report (`.pdf`).
- **Processing**: Rasterizes matching page pairs at high resolution, computes pixel-level delta masks to highlight visual layout changes (red for deletions, green for additions), and extracts text blocks to identify textual modifications.

### Sanitize PDF (`/tools/sanitize-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF document (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Sanitized, privacy-cleared PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Processing**: Strips Extensible Metadata Platform (XMP) packets, Document Information Dictionary entries (Author, Creator, Producer, Title, Keywords), creation/modification timestamps, revision histories, embedded thumbnail streams, and unique document tracking UUIDs.

### Sign PDF (`/tools/sign-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`), optional signature image (`.png`, `.jpg`), signer name, and optional cryptographic certificate (`.p12` / `.pfx`).
- **Output**: Digitally stamped and/or cryptographically signed PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Processing**: Renders clean vector signature badge containing signer identity and UTC timestamp at designated page positions (Bottom-Right, Bottom-Left, Top-Right, Top-Left, or Center).

### PDF to Word (`/tools/pdf-to-word.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`) up to 50 MB.
- **Output**: Native Microsoft Word document (`.docx`).
- **Processing**: High-fidelity page-canvas extraction preserving fonts, vector divider lines, table structures, margins, and embedded graphics.

### PDF to Excel (`/tools/pdf-to-excel.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Microsoft Excel workbook (`.xlsx`).
- **Processing**: PyMuPDF table lattice detection and coordinate parsing with auto-fitted columns, numeric cell typing, and header styling.

### PDF to JPG (`/tools/pdf-to-jpg.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Single JPG for 1-page documents, or a `.zip` archive containing numbered JPG images (`page-001.jpg`, etc.) for multi-page PDFs.
- **Options**: Selectable DPI rendering (100 DPI web, 150 DPI balanced, 200 DPI high-res, 300 DPI print).

### PDF to PowerPoint (`/tools/pdf-to-ppt.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Microsoft PowerPoint presentation (`.pptx`).
- **Processing**: Page-canvas slide generation maintaining aspect ratios and slide boundaries.

### Word to PDF (`/tools/word-to-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Microsoft Word document (`.docx`).
- **Output**: Standard PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Processing**: Headless document compiler preserving 100% of formatting, margins, tables, and typography.

### Excel to PDF (`/tools/excel-to-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Microsoft Excel spreadsheet (`.xlsx`, `.xls`).
- **Output**: Paginated PDF document (`.pdf`).
- **Processing**: Renders genuine spreadsheet gridlines with cell borders and formulas.

### Image to WebP (`/tools/image-to-webp.html`)
- **Input**: Single or multiple image files (`.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`) up to 20 files.
- **Output**: `.webp` image or `.zip` archive containing compressed WebP images.
- **Processing**: High-efficiency WebP compression preserving alpha transparency with configurable quality levels.

### Image to PDF (`/tools/image-to-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Single or multiple image files (`.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`) up to 20 files.
- **Output**: Single consolidated PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Processing**: Scales and centers each image onto standard A4 pages preserving original aspect ratios.

### HTML to PDF (`/tools/html-to-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Local HTML file (`.html`, `.htm`).
- **Output**: Visual rendered PDF document (`.pdf`).
- **Processing**: Renders full CSS styles, layouts, typography, and tables into PDF.

### Merge PDF (`/tools/merge-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Two or more PDF files (`.pdf`) up to 20 files.
- **Output**: Single combined PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Processing**: Uses PDFMergerUtility to concatenate page trees and metadata in designated upload order.

### Split PDF (`/tools/split-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Single PDF (for single range) or `.zip` archive (for multiple ranges).
- **Options**: Page range expressions (e.g. `1-3`, `5`, `8-12`).

### Extract Pages (`/tools/extract-pages.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Standalone PDF containing specified pages.

### Remove Pages (`/tools/remove-pages.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Clean PDF with specified pages excised.

### Compress PDF (`/tools/compress-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Optimized PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Processing**: Multi-stage image downsampling and object stream optimization yielding 60–80% file size reduction.

### Rotate PDF (`/tools/rotate-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Rotated PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Options**: Clockwise rotation by 90°, 180°, or 270°.

### Add Page Numbers (`/tools/add-page-numbers.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Numbered PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Options**: Header or Footer positioning, custom numbering formats.

### Add Watermark (`/tools/add-watermark.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Watermarked PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Options**: Custom text or image overlay with angle, opacity, and scaling controls.

### Protect PDF (`/tools/protect-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`) + User Password.
- **Output**: Encrypted PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Security**: 256-bit AES encryption standard with permission flags.

### Unlock PDF (`/tools/unlock-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Password-protected PDF (`.pdf`) + valid password.
- **Output**: Unrestricted, decrypted PDF (`.pdf`).

---

## 4. REST API Documentation

### Base URL: `https://smartasspdf.com/api/v1`

### Endpoints:
- `GET /tools`: Returns JSON array of all active tools and status.
- `POST /tools/{tool}/jobs`: Initiates conversion job.
  - **Content-Type**: `multipart/form-data`
  - **Form Fields**: `files` (array of File objects), tool-specific form params (`signer`, `position`, `lang`, `dpi`, `ranges`, `password`).
  - **Response (200 OK)**:
    ```json
    {
      "jobId": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
      "tool": "ocr-pdf",
      "status": "COMPLETED",
      "downloadUrl": "/api/v1/jobs/a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890/download",
      "filename": "document_searchable.pdf"
    }
    ```
- `GET /jobs/{jobId}/download`: Streams the resulting binary file with proper `Content-Disposition` attachment headers.
